column1: # Representative searches of the docs site and the page each should find (#2291): a type name finds its Scaladoc page,
# a task finds its guide. scripts/check-site-search.cjs runs every line against the built site's search index (guides
# plus Scaladoc, the one the search box loads) in pages.yml and fails when the page is not among the first three results.
# Format: <query><TAB><expected page, as a site path; .html, a trailing index and an #anchor are ignored>
